# Career Development

- Your individual development plan (see [Onboarding Checklist](onboarding.qmd)) is a living document too — revisit it at least yearly.
- **Recommendation letters.** Ask as early as you can, at least 2 weeks before a deadline. Send your CV, the job/program description, and a few bullet points on what you'd want highlighted — it makes the letter better and faster.
- I'll actively help with mock interviews, chalk talks, and introductions to people in your target field, and prioritize conference travel that builds your visibility, not just mine.
